title: Modélisation mathématiques et intelligence artificielle au service des sciences de la santé et de l'environnement
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Université Hassan II de Casablanca
field: Mathematical modelling and AI for health and environment
about: CIMPA research school in Casablanca, 5-16 July 2027, hosted with Université Hassan II's Faculté des Sciences Ben M'Sick, teaching mathematical modelling and AI tools for health and environmental problems to doctoral students and early-career researchers. Applications close 5 March 2027.
requirements: Aimed at doctoral students and early-career researchers
Applications must be made via the CIMPA application site before the deadline on the school's page

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "Mathematical modelling and AI for health and environment" (field) → "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support"
"Mathematical modelling and AI for health and environment" (field) → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
